name: NAVSTACK-Browser-History-Management
description: A C++ browser history simulator utilizing a custom Linked-List Stack implementation for efficient URL navigation and system-level integration.
author: Aaira Hemal

data_structures.description: Custom stack class managing top-node pointers for back/forward history.

data_structures.purpose: O(1) mapping of URLs to page descriptions.

technical_stack.os_integration: Cross-platform system shell execution (Windows, macOS, Linux)

features: Dynamic memory management with custom Node allocation
Integrated system calls to launch default web browsers
